chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding a man who married off his slave girl to a man, then had intercourse with her, he said: He would be struck with the Penalty (Hadd).

key_terms.يُضْرَبُ الْحَدَّ: he is struck with the Penalty (Hadd)

ai.seo_question: What is the legal ruling for a master who marries off his slave girl and then has intercourse with her?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that when a master marries off his female slave to another man, he retains the right of *shofa'ah* (pre-emption) or ownership rights that allow him to consummate the marriage; however, if he does so, he is subject to the *Hadd* punishment, treating the act as a distinct legal violation rather than simple cohabitation. This ruling highlights the nuanced interplay between ownership (*milk al-yamin*) and marital rights in Shia jurisprudence, distinguishing the master's status from that of a free husband. The emphasis on *Hadd* underscores the seriousness of violating the specific contractual boundaries established by the master's decision to marry off his slave.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umer, from Hammad, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>
regarding a man who got his slave girl married off to a man, then fell upon her. Heasws said: ‘He would be struck with the Penalty (Hadd)’.
